name: Koisuru Natsu no Last Resort
original_name: 恋する夏のラストリゾート
source:
Soutarou just manages to pay his school fees by doing part-time jobs. After helping his kouhai Umi and skipping his shift, he was fired from his part-time job and was having problems making ends meet. Umi felt responsible for his present situation and introduced him to a part-time job at a Southern resort. With deep blue skies, clear seas and vibrant vegetation, the place looked exactly like in the travel magazines.

Moreover, he was surrounded by many girls: energetic imouto-like Sango, affectionate airheaded ojousama Riho, shy and earnest Shiori, and the kind but also strict manager Nagisa. Arriving at the resort, Umi turned to him and asked him to spend the time there as her boyfriend.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
宗太郎靠打工勉强凑齐学费。一次，他为了帮助学妹羽海而耽误了上班，结果被辞退，生计顿时陷入困境。羽海觉得他如今的处境是自己造成的，便介绍他去一处南方度假村打工。湛蓝的天空、清澈的海水与茂盛的草木，让这里宛如旅游杂志中的景色。

而且，他身边还围绕着许多女孩：活泼得像妹妹一样的珊瑚，亲切又天然呆的大小姐莉帆，害羞认真的汐璃，以及温柔却也严厉的经理渚。抵达度假村后，羽海转身向他提出请求，希望他在这里以她男朋友的身份度过这段时光。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
